# hush-hush-python

> Official Python SDK for hush-hush, a secrets-management service. This SDK
> is generated from hush-hush's OpenAPI spec and kept in sync with it
> automatically; `Client` and `AsyncClient` cover create/get/update/delete
> on objects, querying the audit log, and checking what consumes a secret.

Requires Python 3.11+. `pip install hush-hush`. An API key
(`HUSH_HUSH_API_KEY` or passed explicitly) is only needed for write
operations — reads (get, used-by, audit-log query) work without one.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-python/reference/): full reference for `Client`, `AsyncClient` and `APIError`, generated from the source docstrings.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-python): README with install/quickstart, CONTRIBUTING.md for how a spec change becomes a release, and the source itself.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/hush-hush/): the published `hush-hush` package.

## hush-hush

- [hush-hush](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush): the service this SDK talks to, and the source of the OpenAPI spec this SDK is generated from.
